exposure: presence of isolated cleft lip vs cleft lip and palate
cohort: Newborns (n=218) with cleft lip or cleft lip and palate who underwent early cheiloplasty (day 5 to 14 after birth) at two Baby-Friendly Hospitals.
finding: The factors associated with early cleft lip repair, including length of operation, length of ventilation support, and duration of hospital stay, did not significantly affect the rate of breastfeeding.
